# KayKit RPGTools

Original free download folder: `KayKit_RPGToolsBits_1.0_FREE`. Acquired 2026-09-23 from [Kay Lousberg’s KayKit catalog](https://kaylousberg.com/game-assets).

License: CC0 1.0 Universal. The exact included terms are in `LICENSE.txt`. The creator requests credit and asks people not to resell unmodified copies; Topaz credits the creator and uses these files as project content.

Original extracted-folder SHA-256 tree digest: `a34738c568444c53b3ca8d59ae8b52ad09ffd9bbb88b28639292b3d89af05a0b`. Computed over sorted relative file paths and SHA-256 digests of file contents.

Imported: 49 FBX models/animation files and 1 texture atlases. FBX files come from the Unity export where supplied, plus unique character and animation files. Duplicate OBJ, glTF, generic FBX exports, marketing samples, and web shortcuts were omitted. The source download remains in Downloads as a backup.
